reuseAssessment.candidate: dx_raster_wire::detail::eed in dwg2dxf/dx_raster_dwg_wire.h yields bounded APPID role/handle and exact EED item spans, including R2007+ UTF-16; inspectEed/captureEed in dx_iface.cpp show typed token matching and source-name dependency binding.
criticalGaps: Integrate the exact-witness UTF-16 byte comparison and unique, unchanged APPID 0x12 source-name binding into the production profile with an appropriately source-bound read context; the research probe alone cannot qualify output.

Integrate and independently review source-bound dictionary/XRECORD/SCALE observer and end-to-end refusal/retry controls in the production profile; standalone research spans alone do not authorize output.

Prove immutable typed/class-row provenance, same-import-session/projection evidence and output remapping, including typed DXF entry roles; complete NOD and member source-wire observations alone do not establish production graph closure.
Unknown body, string or handle tails must remain refused, with malformed/truncated EED, wrong APPID/roles/targets, destination preservation and same-adapter retry controls.
reuseAssessment.currentResult: Standalone probes match seven dictionary frames including full NOD, primary and nested XRECORDs, and all 32 SCALE source frames to live typed capture and the pinned independent LibreDWG JSON/trace. Typed DXF role transport, production output, immutable baseline and class-row rechecks, end-to-end export rollback/retry and native consumer semantics remain open. No guard or support claim is changed.

limitations: Trace and raw-frame observer describe this one exact physical witness; they do not establish broad producer or version support.
The previous multi-root projected-output result is historical and does not pass on the current head.
This is a test-only projected profile, not whole-source or native consumer semantics.
No external drawing fixture was committed.

Production integration requires a genuine same-import-session LAYER_CONTROL proof and preservation of the matching APPID source snapshot in any test-only projection; existing projected tests may lack those and must not synthesize provenance.

boundedEedProbe.result: PASS: source and peer trace SHA-256 guard, independently decoded APPID 0x12 name ACAD and EED fields, matching live typed EED values, APPID role/handle/name and source-name snapshot, token spans and UTF-16 text bytes. boundedDictionaryProbe.build: The runner builds libdxfrw_test_adapter, then compiles a scratch executable with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror and links it to the built adapter and libdxfrw.
boundedDictionaryProbe.result: PASS: captured raw bodies, detached UTF-16 names, string presence/size footer and ordered handle streams agree with the typed unique dictionaries and the independently decoded LibreDWG 0.14 trace. Seven source frames are tested; this is a standalone research observer and does not relax any output guard.
boundedDictionaryProbe.negativeControls: 184 dictionary mutations covering body, string byte, footer, owner/reactor/item role and target, inserted extra body bit, truncated handle stream and extra handle byte are rejected; original-byte retries succeed for all but the appended-byte case. The extra-body-bit mutation changes the declared body endpoint and is rejected by the fixed-profile endpoint check; it does not independently prove that an otherwise accepted length cannot hide a body gap. Separately, existing EED role/target/text/code/truncation controls pass. These are research-observer controls, not file-export destination or adapter retry tests.

Strict export/rollback, native semantics, immutable same-import provenance and broader support remain open.

disconnectedDictionaryWireHelper.result: PASS: seven AC1024 DICTIONARY frames (0xC, 0xD5, 0x1B8, 0xEE, 0xED, 0x24A and 0x126) and existing 184 per-dictionary fault controls, including raw field/name/footer/role/target changes, inserted body bit, truncated handle stream and extra handle byte; original-byte helper retry succeeds. Additional controls reject countCap, a denied link policy, denied APPID verifier and four EED role/target/text/code mutations, followed by successful original-byte retries.
callerResponsibilities: Independently bind source frame and typed model to the actual completed import and version-qualified source profile; ensure unique identities and full graph/dependency closure.
Supply a noexcept APPID verifier that proves unique APPID name from the same closed read and unchanged source; the probe callback only checks the pinned test snapshot.
Supply a noexcept link policy binding each owner/reactor/item role and encoded length to independent source evidence; a permissive callback does not qualify an output profile.
Inspect staged output and APPID table identity, test destination-preserving failure/retry, and complete external semantic qualification before enabling any route.
limits: ASCII dictionary and EED text only; rejects high-bit string-size footer extension, xdictionary, storage, unqualified EED and capped entries.

Local witness and independently extracted peer evidence are not committed fixtures. The source observer neither proves all XRECORD/SCALE bodies nor validates DXF handle roles, remapping or whole-file conversion.
The per-mutation retries re-observe source bytes; they are not fileExport rollback or native consumer tests.
